findings.finding: Recovery is coupled to whole-root visible metadata and requires visible Save/IR and visible inputs. Normal apply already permits owned hidden controls, so a settings HOLD cannot be adopted when Sequence remains hidden.
findings.required_resolution: Add a distinct bounded collector restricted to the already audited non-root Sequence ancestor. Keep existing root collection visible-only; never add hidden whole-root discovery or navigation.

findings.finding: A cached field_map cannot reveal new, duplicate, renamed, removed or newly eligible inputs. Broad all-hidden enumeration can also treat explicitly unavailable Save/inputs as usable.
findings.required_resolution: Build a fresh full eligible-leaf inventory for each scoped recovery request. Use scope-relative WS_VISIBLE checks on each candidate and its inner ancestors up to but excluding the authenticated scope, ignoring only scope/outer hiding. Require unique nonblank saved-input IDs, unique IR/Save, complete unchanged Python persisted field audit, and before/after inventory/identity checks. Explicitly hidden Save/IR/required inner fields must remain HOLD.

findings.finding: The hidden inventory cannot reacquire global machine/state labels, and mere ownership of an arbitrary scope or cached control is insufficient semantic authentication.
findings.required_resolution: Retain an audited scope identity proof plus separate audited global machine/state handles and expected leaf identities/classes. Validate PID/root/scope ancestry, non-root isolated CommonAncestor, expected classes and current leaf IDs/roles before and after collection. Recheck exact machine, fresh AUTO/RUNNING and editing focus. No hidden global/root fallback when proof is stale. A separate unchanged visible-only reacquisition may re-audit a recreated view without navigation.

findings.finding: The new C# collector requires a real rebuilt bridge. The helper and marked-download probe pin the old DLL SHA-256, and the probe also pins size 21504. Existing packaging copies repository DLL bytes rather than building the bridge.
findings.required_resolution: Build from the reviewed five C# source files on Windows, preserve build/source/toolchain logs and previous DLL evidence, then update active helper/probe hash and actual size. Verify packaged runtime loads the new exact bytes with Internet-zone ADS and rejects tampered/oversize/missing DLLs. Bind source commit, C# hashes, DLL hash, manifest and exact ZIP hash to the final review. Preserve historical releases and evidence.

minimal_design: At initial visible preparation record the isolated Sequence scope and the identity/class evidence needed to authenticate it later; keep global machine/state labels separate.

For connected recovery with a valid existing scope, enumerate only that scope using native HWND APIs. Keep 16384 native visits, 900 eligible leaves, 256 inputs, 64 parent-depth and 1024 AutomationId bounds; reject partial inventories and helper timeouts.

For eligibility, test WS_VISIBLE on the leaf and inner ancestor chain up to but excluding scope. Validate that every visited chain reaches that same owned scope. Ignore scope/outer visibility only. Confirm actual WinForms native-style behavior with tests before claiming this solves the M1 hidden-page case.

Read UIA AutomationId only through existing element-only CacheRequest/AutomationElementMode.None on supported STATIC/BUTTON/EDIT leaves; no root/container/grid FromHandle, Current, UIA patterns/tree traversal or Process table access.

Validate root/PID/scope and exact classes/ancestry before and after metadata acquisition, reject scope==root, confirm current IR/Save CommonAncestor equals the authenticated scope, compare pre/post native candidate membership, and reject identity/class/inner-visibility changes. Do not silently use cached field_map when metadata fails.

Rebuild the current text/toggle map from fresh eligible metadata, detect every new/duplicate/blank ID, require current unique IR EDIT and Save PUSHBUTTON with existing enabled/writable protections, read all eligible fields, and retain the unchanged required/unknown/unsaved field-to-persisted audit.

Use separately retained audited global labels with verified ownership, expected classes/leaf identities and fresh native reads. Require exact selected M1/S3 and AUTO/RUNNING plus no editing before and after recovery. Missing or changed global proof cannot be repaired by hidden root discovery.

Keep the current persisted-before / UI / persisted-after consistency check and two matching recovery signatures separated by the existing interval. A changed map/handle/signature, read failure, file mutation or identity uncertainty resets the recovery candidate.

Adopt only a new epoch after both stable reads. Preserve the session baseline then different fresh valid layer barrier, CSV job/age/hash/content gates, -1 invalid thermometer handling, output min/max and 5 percentage-point guards, settings/image/output-limit admission, and ambiguous-edit/Save sticky fault/no-retry behavior.

If authenticated scope is gone, reparented, recreated or semantically invalid, HOLD. An explicit existing visible-only fresh re-audit may reacquire a visible replacement; do not open tabs, force focus/AUTO or invent hidden profile mappings.

visibility_nuance.schema_fact: assert_fields_match_persisted already ignores UNBOUND_FIELDS plus FIELD_BINDINGS not active for the selected profile. Therefore checkBoxAdaptiveHeating for both profiles and textBoxSpreadingRollerRpm for M1 specifically do not cause unknown-field rejection if inventoried.
visibility_nuance.recommendation: Prefer scope-relative WS_VISIBLE over unqualified all-hidden recovery because it preserves deliberate unavailability of Save and inner controls. Known inactive mappings remain unchanged; absent active saved fields still HOLD.
visibility_nuance.unresolved_empirical_question: Actual WinForms may have provider/control-specific native visibility behavior. A real Windows fixture must show child WS_VISIBLE retention under outer scope hiding and distinguish explicit inner hiding; mock Python tests cannot establish this.
visibility_nuance.all_hidden_alternative: All-hidden plus the unchanged strict schema is fail-closed for unknown fields, but by itself does not preserve explicitly hidden Save unavailability. Do not claim the M1 case fixed without applicable schema and visibility evidence.

windows_synthetic_actual_production_tran: Reproduce old failure with released bridge/helper: prepare visible full M1 schema; hide Sequence and/or outer parent without destroying HWNDs; trigger a settings HOLD. Old recovery should show Save not visible, while CSV observations, connection and chart history remain live.

With the exact rebuilt packaged bridge/helper and default production deadlines, same hidden scope recovers only after two coherent reads, then baseline plus a different fresh layer. Recovery itself performs zero edits, zero Saves and zero navigation; foreground unrelated application remains foreground throughout.

Record native WS_VISIBLE before/after outer hide, then explicitly hide Save alone, IR alone, a required inner field and a required inner panel. Each explicit unavailable case must HOLD and never Save; restoring it requires fresh full stable checks. Include hidden outer parent/root-minimized cases that existing background behavior supports.

Under hidden outer scope, add an eligible unknown input, blank-ID input, duplicate IR, duplicate non-IR, duplicate Save, remove a required input, reparent fields outside scope, and change ID/kind/class. No partial or cached-map adoption; unknown inputs must reach the Python schema audit and block.

Include known ignored inactive controls and intentionally hidden conditional controls; require the real M1/S3 active saved-input sets. No inference of extra mappings. Full profile tests must exercise initial visible preparation before hidden recovery, not start from an unaudited hidden scope.

Reparent/destroy/recreate scope or anchors, wrong PID/root/machine/global-label handle/class/ID, stale or conflicting scope, disabled/read-only IR and disabled/hidden Save. Hidden stale proof must HOLD; only separate visible-only re-audit may reacquire a visible recreated scope.

Mutate class, ancestry, inner visibility or inventory membership while metadata is collected; exceed visit/leaf/input/depth/ID bounds and simulate hung provider. Verify no partial adoption, bounded helper retirement and no Process/grid WM_GETTEXT/WM_GETOBJECT/UIA/tree/scroll calls.

Preserve IDLE, MOVING, AUTO CLEANING, PAUSED, unknown state, active editing, owner aggregate replacement/partial write, changed non-IR values and unsaved UI holds. Returning to AUTO alone must not bypass audit/baseline/fresh-layer gates.

One isolated synthetic hidden-page apply after full recovery must traverse normal CSV/sensor/setting/persistence guards and Save once only; stale/rewritten CSV, invalid -1, job/settings change and uncertain Save paths must never retry. No real equipment.
